jobs.title: Director, Finance Technology & Transformation
jobs.description:
The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation is a critical enabler of Finance modernization and enterprise scale. This role owns the strategy, architecture, and execution of finance systems, integrations, and automation — ensuring that financial data, workflows, and insights flow seamlessly across the organization and franchise network.

As 1-800-GOT-JUNK? evolves toward a Product Operating Model, this leader will help shift Finance from manual processes to a connected, technology-enabled ecosystem. They will partner closely with Finance, Product, and Technology leaders to ensure financial systems evolve in lockstep with new products, pricing models, payment flows, and operating rhythms.

The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation combines financial process knowledge with systems thinking, technical fluency, and cross-functional leadership. They bring structure to complexity, simplify workflows, and ensure Finance technology supports better decisions — not just better reporting.

This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Technology, Product, and the Field
. The Director, Finance Technology & Transformation enables Finance to move faster, think smarter, and scale confidently — automating the manual, simplifying the complex, and ensuring financial systems support the company’s next phase of growth.

Your Impact & What You'll Own

Finance Systems Strategy & Architecture: Own the end-to-end finance systems architecture, ensuring alignment across ERP, CRM, payments, FP&A, and BI platforms. Design scalable, resilient system landscapes that support growth, product expansion, and franchise complexity. Act as the enterprise steward of how financial data moves, connects, and is consumed.
Integration & Data Flow Enablement: Lead the design and delivery of system integrations using integration platforms and native APIs. Ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data flows between finance, product, and operational systems.Establish data governance principles that support a single source of truth and enterprise confidence in financial data.
Product & Technology Partnership: Partner with Product and Technology teams to ensure finance systems support new products, pricing models, and customer journeys. Translate financial requirements into system capabilities early in the product lifecycle. Support experimentation and iteration while maintaining financial discipline and controls.
Leadership, Delivery & Governance: Lead and develop a high-performing team and vendor ecosystem. Set clear priorities, manage dependencies, and drive delivery with accountability. Establish governance for finance systems changes, enhancements, and adoption.
Automation & Process Modernization: Lead the roadmap to automate and optimize core finance processes, including close, AR/AP, forecasting, and reporting. Reduce manual effort and operational risk by simplifying workflows and eliminating redundant processes. Ensure automation efforts balance efficiency, control, and business usability.
Franchise & Field Enablement: Collaborate with franchise partners and field teams to design integrations and tools that simplify their financial workflows. Ensure finance systems scale across the franchise network while respecting local realities and adoption needs. Act as a bridge between enterprise systems and on-the-ground execution.

What You Bring To The Table

8 - 12+ years of experience across software engineering, systems architecture, financial technology, enterprise applications, or finance technology transformation, with a strong track record of building and scaling technology solutions.
Strong engineering and coding foundation — with hands-on experience in JavaScript and/or TypeScript and the ability to write, review, troubleshoot, and understand production code. Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, databases, data pipelines, and integration frameworks.
Advanced integration and data-flow expertise — proven ability to connect systems and make them work together across platforms, data warehouses, and SaaS applications using APIs, middleware, integration platforms, and custom solutions, while ensuring reliable, accurate, and traceable data flows.
Strong technical understanding of modern data and cloud architecture, including relational databases, SQL, APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data platforms, event-driven integrations, and integration technologies. Experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, or similar is highly valued.
Systems thinker and problem solver who can look across the entire technology ecosystem, identify gaps and points of failure, and determine whether the right solution is configuration, integration, automation, or custom development.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and building from the ground up — able to simplify complex problems, make pragmatic technology decisions, and create scalable solutions without over-engineering. Ability to work closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations teams and translate between business needs and technical solutions.
Builder mentality — curious, hands-on, and willing to get into the details. You don't just identify that two systems need to connect; you understand how they should connect and can work with engineers or vendors to make it happen.
Understanding of finance processes such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, month-end close, revenue and payments is an asset
Experience working with Netsuite or finance systems and applications is an asset

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $159,000 to $186,000 per annum (The actual salary offered will be commensurate with education, experience, and internal parity)
Health & Dental: The Total Compensation Package includes Extended Health and dental coverage.
Professional Growth: We focus on your development through our professional development programs.
Wellness: Enjoy a variety of health and wellness initiatives, including access to gym facilities at our corporate head office.
Transparency: Speak to us to learn more about the full details of what we offer.

HYBRID WORK ENVIRONMENT

Our Model: We have created a hybrid work model that helps us get together to Collaborate, Celebrate, and Connect while enjoying flexibility.
Office Presence: For this role’s duty and responsibility, we anticipate that you will come into the office three days a week, Tuesday through Thursday.

THE HIRING PROCESS

Pre-Screen: Let’s talk about your experience, goals, and excitement for this role.
Interviews: Our process is designed to be both engaging and transparent, as we know this is as big of a decision for you as it is for us.
Verification: We conduct reference and background checks as part of our final steps.
Modern Practices: We use audio recording transcription for our interview practices.

About Us

Award-Winning Culture: O2E Brands has been named one of Canada’s Best Workplaces 14 times.
Global Recognition: We made Newsweek’s top 100 list of “Most Loved Workplaces” at #14—the only Canadian company on the list!
Social Presence: Check out our culture on YouTube and social media to see what life is like here.
Inclusivity: We value diversity and inclusivity; accommodations are available upon request.

Ready to take your career to the next level? Apply today!

jobs.title: Leader Amélioration de la Donnée / Data Improvement Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description

Leader Amélioration des Données / Data Improvement Lead

English job description follows***

Description De L'emploi

Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans l'analyse de données et la gestion de la performance, vous avez travaillé sur l'amélioration de processus et la digitalisation, et vous souhaitez évoluer tout en développant de nouvelles compétences ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Leader en amélioration des données pour rejoindre notre équipe Performance Management basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous collaborez étroitement avec les analystes de performance, les équipes des Opérations et l'équipe de digitalisation.

Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Performance Management chargée de développer la standardisation et l'amélioration de la qualité des données de performance pour la chaîne de valeur A220, tout en soutenant la feuille de route de digitalisation. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale et l'autonomie, dans un esprit de soutien mutuel et d'apprentissage collectif.

Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant que point de contact central et facilitateur entre les analystes de la performance opérationnelle et l'équipe de digitalisation. Votre mission sera d'optimiser l'efficacité des processus d'assemblage de l'A220 en coordonnant l'amélioration des données provenant de divers flux : approvisionnement secondaire, SDO ( Supplier Disruption Over Cost ), coûts récurrents (RC) et CVAT ( Customer Value Added Time ). Vous identifierez les besoins en automatisation, harmoniserez les méthodes d'analyse et assurerez la transition des analyses manuelles vers des solutions digitales robustes pour améliorer la rentabilité globale.

Votre Environnement De Travail

Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre.

Parce Que Nous Prenons Soin De Vous

Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions.
Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle.
Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, accès à un service de navette publique entre Laval (station de métro Montmorency) et Mirabel, et une application de covoiturage.
Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale).

Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.

Vos Défis

Assurer le lien principal entre les analystes (Performance, SDO, RC, CVAT) et l'équipe de digitalisation pour traduire les besoins métiers en solutions automatisées;
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et l'exactitude des données de performance issues des flux d'approvisionnement et de production;
Harmoniser la définition et le suivi des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) à travers les différents flux pour assurer une vision transverse de la performance;
Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation des rapports de performance (hebdomadaires, mensuels, trimestriels) et superviser leur mise en œuvre par l'équipe technique;
Consolider les points de blocage majeurs identifiés par les analystes du pôle Performance Management afin de prioriser la feuille de route de digitalisation selon l'impact sur la performance des opérations;
Préparer et présenter des feuilles de route claires et des visualisations de données aux parties prenantes pour soutenir la planification stratégique;
Collaborer avec les départements Opérations, Finances et Qualité pour optimiser la performance globale de la chaîne de valeur.

Votre Profil

Vous détenez un baccalauréat en ingénierie;
Vous détenez un minimum de 10 ans d’expérience dans un système industriel;
Vous possédez une expérience pertinente en analyse de données, en gestion de la performance ou en amélioration de processus;
Vous maîtrisez les outils d'analyse et de visualisation de données tels que Power BI, Skywise et Python;
Vous avez une connaissance approfondie des entrepôts de données, de l'analytique en nuage et de l'automatisation des processus;
Vous possédez de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles;
Vous avez la capacité de vulgariser des concepts de données complexes pour les rendre accessibles aux équipes opérationnelles et de direction;
Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans la définition de cadres de mesure de performance et la création de structures d'analyse complexes.

Ce poste peut impliquer des déplacements professionnels.

Déplacements Requis

Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.

Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant !

Job Description

You have proven experience in data analysis and performance management? Have you worked on process improvement and digitalization, and are you looking to grow and develop new skills? This role is for you!

The A220 Commercial Aircraft Program is seeking a Data Improvement Leader to join our Performance Management team based in Mirabel (Quebec, Canada), where you will collaborate closely with performance analysts, Operations teams, and the digitalization team.

You will be part of the Performance Management team responsible for developing standardization and improving performance data quality for the A220 value chain, supporting the digitalization roadmap. The team is structured to promote cross-functional collaboration and autonomy, fostering mutual support and collective learning.

In this role, you will act as a central point of contact and facilitator between operational performance analysts and the digitalization team. Your mission will be to optimize the efficiency of the A220 assembly processes by coordinating data improvement across various streams: secondary supply, SDO (Supplier Disruption Over Cost), Recurring Costs (RC), and CVAT (Customer Value Added Time). You will identify automation needs, harmonize analytical methods, and ensure the transition from manual analysis to robust digital solutions to improve overall profitability.

Your Working Environment

The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home.

How We Care For You

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan.
Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy (based on operational needs), on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.
Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, access to a public shuttle service between Laval (Montmorency metro station) and Mirabel, and a carpooling application.
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

Your Challenges

Act as the primary liaison between analysts (Performance, SDO, RC, CVAT) and the digitalization team to translate business needs into automated solutions;
Ensure the quality, consistency, and accuracy of performance data collected from supply and production flows;
Harmonize the definition and monitoring of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across various flows to guarantee a cross-functional view of performance;
Identify automation opportunities for performance reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) and oversee their implementation by the technical team;
Consolidate major roadblocks identified by the Performance Management analysts to prioritize the digitalization roadmap based on its impact on Operational Performance;
Strategic Communication: Prepare and present clear roadmaps and data visualizations to stakeholders to support strategic planning;
Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Quality teams to optimize the overall value chain performance.

Your Boarding Pass

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering;
You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in an industrial system;
You possess relevant experience in data analysis, performance management, or process improvement ;
You are proficient in data analysis and visualization tools such as Power BI, Skywise, and Python;
You have in-depth knowledge of data warehousing, cloud analytics, and process automation;
You possess strong problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams;
You have the ability to simplify complex data concepts for operational and executive leadership teams;
You have proven experience in defining performance measurement frameworks and creating complex analytical structures.

Business Travel May Be Required For This Position.

Travel requirements: < 5% (Occasional trips to the United States)

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer / VP of Technology
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief Technology Officer / VP of Technology based in Canada.

As the executive technology leader for a global energy advisory firm of roughly 300 professionals across Europe and North America, you will hold complete accountability for the entire technical ecosystem. This pivotal role balances high-level commercial impact with a practical, hands-on approach, bridging internal corporate systems with sophisticated client-facing digital products. You will lead cross-border enterprise IT, oversee a distributed international team, direct managed services, and orchestrate modern AI and automation strategies to scale operations efficiently. Operating in an agile, business-first environment without heavy administrative friction, your technical vision and execution will directly shape company growth, vendor partnerships, and core client capabilities across multiple regions.

Accountabilities

Enterprise IT and operations across multiple countries, including network infrastructure, cybersecurity, endpoint management, global service desk, and identity and access management.
Internal business systems and reporting architecture, maintaining and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Finance & Operations, and associated data workflows.
Portfolio management of client-facing platforms in two regions, defining product roadmaps, ensuring system connectivity, and driving continuous platform maintenance.
AI and automation integration, collaborating directly with business units to optimize processes and deploy modern tools that drive growth without proportional headcount expansion.
Strategic technology cost management, managing global vendor relationships, licensing negotiations, and outsourced managed-service arrangements.
Leadership and mentorship of a distributed, multi-country technology team, fostering a high-performance culture across time zones.

Requirements

Proven track record leading technology strategy and execution within a mid-sized organization, encompassing both internal business systems and client-facing digital products.
Deep experience in the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Microsoft 365 environments.
Hands-on operational leadership style, actively engaging with and building upon modern tools rather than solely delegating or overseeing high-level governance.
Strong commercial acumen with demonstrable success in vendor negotiations, licensing optimization, and multi-country technology budget management.
High adaptability and cross-cultural communication skills required to lead distributed teams and support operations across various time zones.
Pragmatic, business-first mindset suited for a lean, efficient environment that values speed and outcomes over heavy process or top-down IT governance.
Familiarity with modern data platform architecture (Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI), experience navigating corporate ownership transitions, or prior energy sector exposure is highly advantageous.

Benefits

Competitive executive salary package reflecting the impact and scale of the role.
Fully remote work model offering geographic and schedule flexibility.
Comprehensive healthcare and medical coverage plan.
Global business exposure and opportunities for professional leadership growth in a scaling, international energy advisory environment.
Direct access to executive decision-makers and key business stakeholders in a streamlined, low-bureaucracy organizational culture.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.title: Regional Director, Data & AI
jobs.description:
Job Summary & Requirements

The Regional Director, Data & Artificial Intelligence
provides strategic and operational leadership for regional data, analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, and data governance services within the Regional Digital Health portfolio. The role is responsible for advancing a regional Data and AI strategy that supports data-driven decision making, responsible AI adoption, innovation, and improved clinical, operational, financial, research, and patient outcomes across Central Region North organizations.

Working collaboratively with hospital, research, and industry partners, the Director oversees the development of foundational data and AI capabilities, governance frameworks, and advanced analytics solutions while ensuring compliance with privacy, ethical, and regulatory requirements. The role also supports research innovation through secure and responsible use of data assets.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in health informatics, Data Science, Information Management, Computer Science, Analytics, Business Administration, Health Administration, or related field.
Masters or Doctoral degree considered an asset.
Formal education or certification in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, Data Governance, or Digital Transformation considered an asset.

Competencies:

Strategic leadership and systems thinking
Healthcare analytics and performance measurement
Data governance and information management
Business intelligence and decision support
Artificial intelligence and machine learning governance
Data science and advanced analytics
Data architecture and engineering principles
Privacy, security, ethics, and regulatory compliance
Healthcare research and innovation ecosystems
Executive communication and influence
Change leadership and stakeholder engagement
Financial and business case development
Partnership and relationship management
Program and portfolio management
Innovation leadership and value realization

Responsibilities:

Provide strategic and operational leadership for regional Data, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Governance services.
Lead the development and execution of Data and AI strategies, roadmaps, governance frameworks, and investment plans that advance digital health transformation and improve organizational performance.
Build, coach, and sustain high-performing multidisciplinary teams while supporting workforce development, succession planning, and a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and service excellence.
Oversee data governance, privacy, stewardship, quality, interoperability, security, ethical AI practices, and compliance with legislative, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
Advance business intelligence, decision support, self-service analytics, predictive analytics, modern data platforms, and scalable architecture to enable timely, accurate, and actionable insights.
Guide the responsible evaluation, prioritization, implementation, monitoring, and adoption of AI solutions that support patient care, operational efficiency, workforce productivity, research, and healthcare system outcomes.
Develop trusted partnerships with executives, clinicians, operational leaders, researchers, Ontario Health, academic institutions, vendors, and regional partners to align priorities and accelerate innovation.
Represent RVH and the Central Region North LDG in regional, provincial, and national Data and AI forums, serving as executive sponsor and subject matter leader for regional initiatives.
Reduce the cost and increase the maturity of Data and AI in the region through rationalization, standardization and centralization of resources, services and digital platforms.
Lead and chair regional Data Governance & Analytics and AI Governance committees, ensuring effective decision-making, accountability, prioritization, risk management, and alignment with organizational and regional strategic objectives.
Provide periodic reporting and recommendations to executive leadership teams, governance committees, and Boards regarding Data and AI strategy, performance, risks, compliance, investment priorities, and realized outcomes.

Exhibits the core values of Royal Victoria Regional Health Centre: Inspire Trust, Be Kind, Be Bold, Do Great Things, Team Up.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
Vice President, Finance

Headway Group is leading the search for a Vice President, Finance on behalf of our client, a growing Canadian health services platform building an integrated network of specialized mobility care providers. Reporting to the CEO and serving as a key member of a small leadership team, the Vice President will inherit a lean finance team and take a hands-on role in developing its capabilities, building the broader function, and establishing the financial infrastructure required to support acquisition-led and organic growth.

The role will work with acquired businesses, often smaller, practitioner-led organizations, to integrate them into a scalable operating model and unlock organic growth. Success will require the judgment and credibility to advise the CEO, make timely decisions, and prioritize the investments in people, systems and processes required to build a high performing finance function.

This is a remote role with the ability to operate in an Eastern time zone.

Outcomes

Create an integrated finance platform.
Develop a scalable finance operating model across multiple entities without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Improve visibility into business performance.
Establish reliable, consolidated reporting, appropriate KPIs and forward-looking analysis that enables leadership to understand profitability, cash generation, operating performance and areas of opportunity.

Strengthen financial discipline.
Improve controls, forecasting, treasury, cash management, lender reporting and financial governance to support a growing and increasingly complex organization.

Support acquisition and integration.
Partner with the CEO and Corporate Development on financial diligence, valuation assumptions, quality-of-earnings analysis and integration planning. Ensure acquired businesses can be effectively incorporated into enterprise reporting and financial processes.

Build the finance organization for the next stage of growth.
Assess existing capabilities, clarify accountabilities and develop a high-performing finance team capable of supporting both local operations and enterprise priorities.

Act as a trusted partner to the CEO.
Translate financial and operating information into clear business decisions and bring constructive challenge to investment, resource allocation and performance discussions.

The Leadership Profile

A finance leader who brings enterprise level judgment, commercial acumen and the willingness, patience and urgency to get into the operating details. This finance leader knows that effective finance leadership is more than controls. It is about creating better information, better decisions and stronger operating performance. Critical to this role is the ability to build the finance capability required to turn acquisition led growth into an integrated, better performing business.

Relevant Experience:

Built, integrated or materially improved finance capabilities in growing organizations, ideally across multiple entities or locations.
Experience in investor backed, acquisition-led growth in multi-site healthcare, professional services or another distributed operating environment would be particularly relevant.
The commercial judgment and communication skills to partner effectively with a CEO, investors, lenders and operating leaders.
Experience building and developing finance teams.
Strong budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, KPI and decision-support capabilities.
A strong foundation in controllership, reporting, controls, treasury and financial governance; a CPA designation is preferred.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Full-time | Reports to the CEO
Build the finance function at a fast-growing senior care technology company shipping hardware to 24 countries.

The company

We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.
Why now

We are scaling. One of the largest deals in our history is in delivery, our consumer product launches in January, and we are preparing our next raise. Every one of those runs on numbers leadership can trust: a close that lands on time, a forecast that ties sales to inventory and cash, and books that hold up in diligence. This is the moment to bring in the leader who owns it.
The role

This is the senior finance role at Pontosense. You own the close, the forecast, controls and the numbers behind our next raise, across our entities in Canada and China. You work directly with the CEO and the leadership team, and you are in the room with investors. This is a builder role first and an operator role second. You set up how finance runs here, then you run it.
What you'll own

A monthly close that is reliable and consolidated across Canada and China, landing by business day 10
A forecast the company actually runs on, with sales, inventory and cash tied together
Product costing that is right: landed cost, COGS and inventory planning for hardware built overseas
The raise: the model, the data room and investor reporting, with you in the room
Annual financials prepared and audited on time, and the relationships with our auditors and tax advisors
Controls that hold up across two countries: approvals, spend and intercompany
A seat at the leadership table

What year one looks like

The books close on time every month, consolidated. The forecast is trusted, and inventory is planned, not guessed. Audited financials are current, and our next raise runs on numbers that hold up in diligence.
How we work

Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
Real impact. There is more room to make a difference here than at a company ten times our size.
Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.

This is for you if

You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
You're happy to be the person who just fixes it

This isn't for you if

You want a playbook handed to you
You need a big team before you can move

You'll thrive here if

You are a CPA who started in audit, then grew with a product or technology company, with promotions along the way
You have owned the close and built the model yourself, not just reviewed them
You have worked with inventory, COGS and supply chain costing. Multi-entity or international consolidation is a strong plus
You have worked with investors, a board or lenders, or are ready to step into that
You explain the numbers plainly to people outside finance, and decide with incomplete information
You are as happy reconciling an account yourself as setting the strategy

You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.
Where this goes

As we raise and scale, this role grows into leading a finance team of your own.
What you get

A sensor for your parents, on us
Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
Health, dental and vision benefits

The details

Pay: $160,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review

Our Commitment

At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.
If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.
We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Director of Finance is responsible for the sound financial management of Multiview and the delivery of efficient, value-added financial and administrative services. The incumbent leads the regular operations of the finance team and strive to support and improve the operations of the whole company.

The Director of Finance provides guidance and direction on financial and operating priorities to ensure that Multiview operates in accordance with organizational strategic directions and manages the financial and accounting department for Multiview.

The incumbent oversees all accounting function for Multiview’s US and Canadian operations, evaluating, and directing accounting, audits, development of financial policies, procedures that need implementation. Oversee monthly consolidated financial statements, annual budget preparations, executive payrolls, financial reports, and analysis for the chief executives.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Finance leadership:

Oversee activities associated with the finance and accounting function.
Oversee accurate and timely financial reporting for internal and external stakeholders including the CFO and CEO
Manage the accounting function including A/P, A/R, Collections, Payroll, etc.
Lead and drive monthly and quarterly close cycles
Ensure tax and compliance filings including S&U tax compliance and nexus analysis
Develop, implement, and apply accounting and finance policies and procedures in accordance with GAAP
Prepare and maintain financial metrics and industry standard metrics (SaaS)
Manage treasury and forex management programs alongside the CFO, including hedging
Assist with the development of annual financial budgets and ongoing resource allocation planning.
Coaching, training, and retaining a skilled finance team
Own and manage the annual audit process with external audit partner; and
Drive automation and adoption of technologies, including AI, within the finance and reporting function

Operations leadership:

Implement processes, practices, and policies into place for a strong organizational control environment that supports corporate security practices.
Develop and monitor business performance metrics and support departments designing actions that focus on improving results and build value for Multiview and clients.
Partner with other departments, such as GTM and Rev Ops, to maintain and improve processes, billings, pricing, and data accuracy across the business
Support the CFO with ad-hoc analysis, strategic finance initiatives, and broader team goals

The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000.00 CAD annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

COMPETENCIES PORTFOLIO:

Interpersonal Skills
–Ability to effectively communicate and work with various stakeholders both internally and externally. Strong verbal communication skills are required.
Problem Solving
- Proactive in anticipating and resolving complex problems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to meet the requirements of the project are required.
Conflict Management
– conflict can arise from time to time during a project, and implementation project managers are skilled negotiators and conflict managers. They know how to address both sides of the argument and can provide helpful solutions for everyone.
Organization
– Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines and prioritize tasks to ensure a smooth client support experience and operational excellence.
Teamwork
– works with multiple teams cross-functionally and must know how to effectively address the needs of each team while always keeping the client’s outcomes as the driver.
Initiative
– Seeks, accepts, and completes new tasks using own initiative; works independently with little supervision.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor’s degree in finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience Level:
Minimum 7 years
leadership experience leading finance teams
Experience operating in multi-currency and multi-entity environments with consolidation reporting
Comfortable working in an Outlook/Windows environment and experience implementing new systems and AI initiatives
Previous experience in an financial leadership role and participation in organization-wide reporting and compliance activities.
Effective organizational skills with the ability to effectively influence others and successfully resolve challenging projects.
Analytical, and data-driven, but trust your instincts in order to move fast.
Flexible in approaches to dealing with challenges but seek to create scalable processes within a growing company.
Willingness to directly support the team with work if required to ensure outcomes are met.
Strong attention to detail
Ability to effectively multi-task in a deadline-driven atmosphere
Possess a high level of integrity, autonomy, and self-motivation.
Experience effectively representing Multiview’s values, building, and advancing the reputation of the company and its clients.

PREFERRED:

A recognized and valid professional accounting designation
Experience with and knowledge of Multiview Financial Software would be considered an asset

Experience comes in many forms, many skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. If your experience is this close to what we are looking for, consider applying. We know that diversity of thought makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, which is why we are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encouraging everyone to apply.

ABOUT US:

Multiview builds powerful, easy-to-use financial applications for clients across North America. As a leader in the ERP/Financial Software industry, we partner with sophisticated clients across multiple industries to End Month End™.
We are extremely proud of the company we have built. Bringing together professionals with diverse backgrounds, talents, and expertise is vital to making our company stronger. Our people-first culture is our biggest advantage, and we are excited to share that commitment with you!

WHY JOIN MULTIVIEW?

At Multiview, you can make an impact that matters in a way that you never thought possible. With endless opportunities at every turn, and a company culture built to empower and develop our people to be the best they can be, Multiview is THE Software Company for you to learn, grow, create, connect, and lead. We do this by taking care of our employees first.
We strongly believe that a great job should keep you happy both at work and in life and we encourage that by offering:
4 weeks vacation to start, additional paid time off to supplement work-life balance, wellness, and mental health days.
Company paid competitive Benefits including Extended Health, Dental, Vision and more.
Continuous growth opportunities, and leadership development

The Regional Director, Data & Artificial Intelligence
provides strategic and operational leadership for regional data, analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, and data governance services within the Regional Digital Health portfolio. The role is responsible for advancing a regional Data and AI strategy that supports data-driven decision making, responsible AI adoption, innovation, and improved clinical, operational, financial, research, and patient outcomes across Central Region North organizations.

Working collaboratively with hospital, research, and industry partners, the Director oversees the development of foundational data and AI capabilities, governance frameworks, and advanced analytics solutions while ensuring compliance with privacy, ethical, and regulatory requirements. The role also supports research innovation through secure and responsible use of data assets.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in health informatics, Data Science, Information Management, Computer Science, Analytics, Business Administration, Health Administration, or related field.
Masters or Doctoral degree considered an asset.
Formal education or certification in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, Data Governance, or Digital Transformation considered an asset.

Strategic leadership and systems thinking
Healthcare analytics and performance measurement
Data governance and information management
Business intelligence and decision support
Artificial intelligence and machine learning governance
Data science and advanced analytics
Data architecture and engineering principles
Privacy, security, ethics, and regulatory compliance
Healthcare research and innovation ecosystems
Executive communication and influence

Build, coach, and sustain high-performing multidisciplinary teams while supporting workforce development, succession planning, and a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and service excellence.

new_jobs.title: Vice President Finance
new_jobs.description:
Vice President, Finance

Headway Group is leading the search for a Vice President, Finance on behalf of our client, a growing Canadian health services platform building an integrated network of specialized mobility care providers. Reporting to the CEO and serving as a key member of a small leadership team, the Vice President will inherit a lean finance team and take a hands-on role in developing its capabilities, building the broader function, and establishing the financial infrastructure required to support acquisition-led and organic growth.

The role will work with acquired businesses, often smaller, practitioner-led organizations, to integrate them into a scalable operating model and unlock organic growth. Success will require the judgment and credibility to advise the CEO, make timely decisions, and prioritize the investments in people, systems and processes required to build a high performing finance function.

This is a remote role with the ability to operate in an Eastern time zone.

Outcomes

Create an integrated finance platform.
Develop a scalable finance operating model across multiple entities without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Improve visibility into business performance.
Establish reliable, consolidated reporting, appropriate KPIs and forward-looking analysis that enables leadership to understand profitability, cash generation, operating performance and areas of opportunity.

Strengthen financial discipline.
Improve controls, forecasting, treasury, cash management, lender reporting and financial governance to support a growing and increasingly complex organization.

Support acquisition and integration.
Partner with the CEO and Corporate Development on financial diligence, valuation assumptions, quality-of-earnings analysis and integration planning. Ensure acquired businesses can be effectively incorporated into enterprise reporting and financial processes.

Build the finance organization for the next stage of growth.
Assess existing capabilities, clarify accountabilities and develop a high-performing finance team capable of supporting both local operations and enterprise priorities.

Act as a trusted partner to the CEO.
Translate financial and operating information into clear business decisions and bring constructive challenge to investment, resource allocation and performance discussions.

The Leadership Profile

A finance leader who brings enterprise level judgment, commercial acumen and the willingness, patience and urgency to get into the operating details. This finance leader knows that effective finance leadership is more than controls. It is about creating better information, better decisions and stronger operating performance. Critical to this role is the ability to build the finance capability required to turn acquisition led growth into an integrated, better performing business.

Relevant Experience:

Built, integrated or materially improved finance capabilities in growing organizations, ideally across multiple entities or locations.
Experience in investor backed, acquisition-led growth in multi-site healthcare, professional services or another distributed operating environment would be particularly relevant.
The commercial judgment and communication skills to partner effectively with a CEO, investors, lenders and operating leaders.
Experience building and developing finance teams.
Strong budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, KPI and decision-support capabilities.
A strong foundation in controllership, reporting, controls, treasury and financial governance; a CPA designation is preferred.

Job Description:

Leader Amélioration des Données / Data Improvement Lead

English job description follows***

Description de l'emploi :

Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans l'analyse de données et la gestion de la performance, vous avez travaillé sur l'amélioration de processus et la digitalisation, et vous souhaitez évoluer tout en développant de nouvelles compétences ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Leader en amélioration des données pour rejoindre notre équipe Performance Management basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous collaborez étroitement avec les analystes de performance, les équipes des Opérations et l'équipe de digitalisation.

Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Performance Management chargée de développer la standardisation et l'amélioration de la qualité des données de performance pour la chaîne de valeur A220, tout en soutenant la feuille de route de digitalisation. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale et l'autonomie, dans un esprit de soutien mutuel et d'apprentissage collectif.

Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant que point de contact central et facilitateur entre les analystes de la performance opérationnelle et l'équipe de digitalisation. Votre mission sera d'optimiser l'efficacité des processus d'assemblage de l'A220 en coordonnant l'amélioration des données provenant de divers flux : approvisionnement secondaire, SDO ( Supplier Disruption Over Cost ), coûts récurrents (RC) et CVAT ( Customer Value Added Time ). Vous identifierez les besoins en automatisation, harmoniserez les méthodes d'analyse et assurerez la transition des analyses manuelles vers des solutions digitales robustes pour améliorer la rentabilité globale.

Votre environnement de travail:

Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre.

Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :

Vos défis :

Assurer le lien principal entre les analystes (Performance, SDO, RC, CVAT) et l'équipe de digitalisation pour traduire les besoins métiers en solutions automatisées;
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et l'exactitude des données de performance issues des flux d'approvisionnement et de production;
Harmoniser la définition et le suivi des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) à travers les différents flux pour assurer une vision transverse de la performance;
Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation des rapports de performance (hebdomadaires, mensuels, trimestriels) et superviser leur mise en œuvre par l'équipe technique;
Consolider les points de blocage majeurs identifiés par les analystes du pôle Performance Management afin de prioriser la feuille de route de digitalisation selon l'impact sur la performance des opérations;
Préparer et présenter des feuilles de route claires et des visualisations de données aux parties prenantes pour soutenir la planification stratégique;
Collaborer avec les départements Opérations, Finances et Qualité pour optimiser la performance globale de la chaîne de valeur.

Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans la définition de cadres de mesure de performance et la création de structures d'analyse complexes.

Job description :

You have proven experience in data analysis and performance management? Have you worked on process improvement and digitalization, and are you looking to grow and develop new skills? This role is for you!

The A220 Commercial Aircraft Program is seeking a Data Improvement Leader to join our Performance Management team based in Mirabel (Quebec, Canada), where you will collaborate closely with performance analysts, Operations teams, and the digitalization team.

You will be part of the Performance Management team responsible for developing standardization and improving performance data quality for the A220 value chain, supporting the digitalization roadmap. The team is structured to promote cross-functional collaboration and autonomy, fostering mutual support and collective learning.

In this role, you will act as a central point of contact and facilitator between operational performance analysts and the digitalization team. Your mission will be to optimize the efficiency of the A220 assembly processes by coordinating data improvement across various streams: secondary supply, SDO (Supplier Disruption Over Cost), Recurring Costs (RC), and CVAT (Customer Value Added Time). You will identify automation needs, harmonize analytical methods, and ensure the transition from manual analysis to robust digital solutions to improve overall profitability.

Your working environment:

The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home.

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan.
Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy (based on operational needs), on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.
Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, access to a public shuttle service between Laval (Montmorency metro station) and Mirabel, and a carpooling application.
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

Your challenges:

Act as the primary liaison between analysts (Performance, SDO, RC, CVAT) and the digitalization team to translate business needs into automated solutions;
Ensure the quality, consistency, and accuracy of performance data collected from supply and production flows;
Harmonize the definition and monitoring of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across various flows to guarantee a cross-functional view of performance;
Identify automation opportunities for performance reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) and oversee their implementation by the technical team;
Consolidate major roadblocks identified by the Performance Management analysts to prioritize the digitalization roadmap based on its impact on Operational Performance;
Strategic Communication: Prepare and present clear roadmaps and data visualizations to stakeholders to support strategic planning;
Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Quality teams to optimize the overall value chain performance.

Your boarding pass:

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering;
You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in an industrial system;
You possess relevant experience in data analysis, performance management, or process improvement ;
You are proficient in data analysis and visualization tools such as Power BI, Skywise, and Python;
You have in-depth knowledge of data warehousing, cloud analytics, and process automation;
You possess strong problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams;
You have the ability to simplify complex data concepts for operational and executive leadership teams;
You have proven experience in defining performance measurement frameworks and creating complex analytical structures.

Business Travel May Be Required For This Position.

Travel requirements: < 5% (Occasional trips to the United States)

new_jobs.title: Director of Finance
new_jobs.description:
Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Director of Finance is responsible for the sound financial management of Multiview and the delivery of efficient, value-added financial and administrative services. The incumbent leads the regular operations of the finance team and strive to support and improve the operations of the whole company.

The Director of Finance provides guidance and direction on financial and operating priorities to ensure that Multiview operates in accordance with organizational strategic directions and manages the financial and accounting department for Multiview.

The incumbent oversees all accounting function for Multiview’s US and Canadian operations, evaluating, and directing accounting, audits, development of financial policies, procedures that need implementation. Oversee monthly consolidated financial statements, annual budget preparations, executive payrolls, financial reports, and analysis for the chief executives.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Finance leadership:

Oversee activities associated with the finance and accounting function.
Oversee accurate and timely financial reporting for internal and external stakeholders including the CFO and CEO
Manage the accounting function including A/P, A/R, Collections, Payroll, etc.
Lead and drive monthly and quarterly close cycles
Ensure tax and compliance filings including S&U tax compliance and nexus analysis
Develop, implement, and apply accounting and finance policies and procedures in accordance with GAAP
Prepare and maintain financial metrics and industry standard metrics (SaaS)
Manage treasury and forex management programs alongside the CFO, including hedging
Assist with the development of annual financial budgets and ongoing resource allocation planning.
Coaching, training, and retaining a skilled finance team
Own and manage the annual audit process with external audit partner; and
Drive automation and adoption of technologies, including AI, within the finance and reporting function

Operations leadership:

Implement processes, practices, and policies into place for a strong organizational control environment that supports corporate security practices.
Develop and monitor business performance metrics and support departments designing actions that focus on improving results and build value for Multiview and clients.
Partner with other departments, such as GTM and Rev Ops, to maintain and improve processes, billings, pricing, and data accuracy across the business
Support the CFO with ad-hoc analysis, strategic finance initiatives, and broader team goals

The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000.00 CAD annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

COMPETENCIES PORTFOLIO:

Interpersonal Skills
–Ability to effectively communicate and work with various stakeholders both internally and externally. Strong verbal communication skills are required.
Problem Solving
- Proactive in anticipating and resolving complex problems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to meet the requirements of the project are required.
Conflict Management
– conflict can arise from time to time during a project, and implementation project managers are skilled negotiators and conflict managers. They know how to address both sides of the argument and can provide helpful solutions for everyone.
Organization
– Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines and prioritize tasks to ensure a smooth client support experience and operational excellence.
Teamwork
– works with multiple teams cross-functionally and must know how to effectively address the needs of each team while always keeping the client’s outcomes as the driver.
Initiative
– Seeks, accepts, and completes new tasks using own initiative; works independently with little supervision.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor’s degree in finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience Level:
Minimum 7 years
leadership experience leading finance teams
Experience operating in multi-currency and multi-entity environments with consolidation reporting
Comfortable working in an Outlook/Windows environment and experience implementing new systems and AI initiatives
Previous experience in an financial leadership role and participation in organization-wide reporting and compliance activities.
Effective organizational skills with the ability to effectively influence others and successfully resolve challenging projects.
Analytical, and data-driven, but trust your instincts in order to move fast.
Flexible in approaches to dealing with challenges but seek to create scalable processes within a growing company.
Willingness to directly support the team with work if required to ensure outcomes are met.
Strong attention to detail
Ability to effectively multi-task in a deadline-driven atmosphere
Possess a high level of integrity, autonomy, and self-motivation.
Experience effectively representing Multiview’s values, building, and advancing the reputation of the company and its clients.

PREFERRED:

A recognized and valid professional accounting designation
Experience with and knowledge of Multiview Financial Software would be considered an asset

Experience comes in many forms, many skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. If your experience is this close to what we are looking for, consider applying. We know that diversity of thought makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, which is why we are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encouraging everyone to apply.

ABOUT US:

Multiview builds powerful, easy-to-use financial applications for clients across North America. As a leader in the ERP/Financial Software industry, we partner with sophisticated clients across multiple industries to End Month End™.
We are extremely proud of the company we have built. Bringing together professionals with diverse backgrounds, talents, and expertise is vital to making our company stronger. Our people-first culture is our biggest advantage, and we are excited to share that commitment with you!

WHY JOIN MULTIVIEW?

At Multiview, you can make an impact that matters in a way that you never thought possible. With endless opportunities at every turn, and a company culture built to empower and develop our people to be the best they can be, Multiview is THE Software Company for you to learn, grow, create, connect, and lead. We do this by taking care of our employees first.
We strongly believe that a great job should keep you happy both at work and in life and we encourage that by offering:
4 weeks vacation to start, additional paid time off to supplement work-life balance, wellness, and mental health days.
Company paid competitive Benefits including Extended Health, Dental, Vision and more.
Continuous growth opportunities, and leadership development
